prompt:
Assess ISO readiness for: Industry: Plastics Injection Molding, Company Size: 95 employees, Pain Points: Mold changeover takes too long causing quality drift, no SPC on critical dimensions, operator training is buddy-system only, customer audits finding repeat issues

Return a single JSON object with EXACTLY these fields:
- readinessScore (string): overall ISO readiness score
- gaps (string): identified gaps in current system
- recommendations (string): recommended actions to address gaps
- standards (string): applicable ISO standards

End your response with exactly one line: ANSWER: <your JSON object>
response: ANSWER: {"readinessScore":"Low","gaps":"Extended mold changeover times, lack of Statistical Process Control (SPC) on critical dimensions, insufficient formalized operator training, recurring issues identified during customer audits","recommendations":"Implement a structured mold changeover process to reduce time and maintain quality, introduce SPC for monitoring critical dimensions, develop a formal training program for operators, establish a robust corrective and preventive action (CAPA) system to address recurring issues","standards":"ISO 9001:2015, ISO/TS 16949 (for automotive sector if applicable), ISO 13053 (for Six Sigma and SPC)"}
